text:
maya: quick idea — try a low-risk path for background compaction: journaling each move so recovery is bounded and we can run in prod with minimal scan overhead.
alex: curious — what does the journal look like? small append-only records per in-flight move?
maya: yeah: write a compact entry: slab_id, src_gen, dst_alloc_id, attempted_by, timestamp, checksum. append, fsync. on success append a tombstone/complete entry. on restart only replay records with no completion.
chen: that avoids O(#slabs) boot work which has bitten us before. +1. how do we handle the temp allocation blowup risk? copying needs extra host memory.
alex: admission controller. each host exposes N "move slots"; allocator requests a slot before starting allocation/copy. slot allocation considers free mem + KV cache pressure. if no slot, return DEFER.
maya: handshake API sketch: allocator -> residency_manager: `ReserveMove(slab_id, priority)` returns {status: OK|DEFER, reason: "pinned"|"inflight_io"|"low_mem", slot_id}. release via `ReleaseMove(slot_id, result)`.
ops-bot: deploy note: add journaling migration and feature-flag gating.
chen: what about pinned GPU mappings? we must not move slabs with active GPU mappings. the residency layer already tracks pin counts but we need a fast check.
alex: residency should return a hint along with DEFER: `retry_after_ms` or `evict_signal_id` so allocator can requeue or trigger eviction workflows.
maya: crash-safety: we do a three-phase transition: allocate temp -> copy -> journal append swap entry -> atomic slab descriptor swap -> journal append complete -> free old. If crash between copy and journal append, cleaner sees incomplete and frees temp.
chen: generation numbers on slab descriptors are important. each swap bumps `gen` and we compare-and-swap on descriptor update to avoid ABA.
alex: performance concern: copying live objects can hit p99. mitigation: chunked copy + yield to request path. config knobs: `defrag.max_copy_bps`, `defrag.chunk_size_bytes`, `defrag.yield_ms`.
maya: sample config: ```[defrag]
enabled=false
concurrency_slots=3
max_copy_bps=80mb
chunk_size=64kb
yield_ms=5
journal_path=/var/lib/runtime/defrag_journal
```
chen: telemetry & alerts: `defrag.in_flight_moves`, `defrag.pending_queue`, `defrag.move_failures{reason}`, `defrag.recovery_actions`. alert if pending grows > threshold for >1h.
alex: operationally: start with observe-only mode where we simulate moves and emit the would-be journal entries but never mutate descriptors. roll out to a small fleet subset.
maya: implementation plan: (1) implement journal writer/reader lib (fsync safe small files), (2) handshake proto and RPC auth (mTLS internal only), (3) admission slot manager + metrics, (4) observe-mode simulation, (5) full move with journal and recovery worker.
chen: security: RPC auth + role check. audit logs for moves (tenant id, operator, slab_id).
ops-bot: checklist updated: add journal migration, feature flag, docs for handshake API, telemetry targets.
alex: one more: add sampling for telemetry to avoid high-cardinality noise from very hot slabs. e.g. only emit full slab stats for 1% of moves.
maya: I'll draft a short RFC with diagram and proto defs and drop it here by EOD Friday. feedback welcome.
